data.name: Sanatkum
data.gender_notes: Sanatkum is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sanatkum refers to one who is eternally young and immortal, derived from Sanat (eternal) and Kumara (youth). The name Sanatkum carries the meaning “Eternal youth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sanatkum usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal youth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine wisdom and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Sanatkum belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal youth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sanatkum total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sanatkum carries a deep cultural significance in Hinduism. Sanat Kumar is recognized as one of the ten Maharshi sages who are renowned for their wisdom, devotion, and commitment to knowledge. They are revered for their purity, humility, and detachment from material desires. In Hindu literature, Sanatkumar is often depicted as having attained the highest state of spiritual enlightenment and is addressed as the embodiment of eternal youth and divine knowledge. This name is a reminder of Hinduism's significance placed on wisdom, knowledge, and the pursuit of spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Sanatkum holds immense spiritual significance in Hinduism as it embodies the essence of the eternal, ever-youthful divine spirit. Sanat represents the eternal nature of the Supreme Being, while Kumar refers to the eternal youth and divinity within each individual. It signifies the belief that one's spiritual essence is eternal and youthful, forever in pursuit of spiritual growth and enlightenment. This name inspires the bearer to aspire towards the highest spiritual goals, to seek knowledge and wisdom, and to maintain a youthful spirit throughout their life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sanatkum represents the eternal and infinite soul (Sanat) and the invincible warrior (Kumar) within us, encouraging us to fight the internal and external battles of life with courage and determination.

historical_references.reference: The name Sanatkumar is mentioned in the Mahabharata, a Sanskrit epic consisting of 100,000 verses. Sanatkumar was one of the eight Sapta Rishis (Seven Sages) and the youngest of them, who lived during the Satya Yuga (Golden Age).

Sanatkumar is also mentioned in the Puranas, a collection of eighteen major Sanskrit texts which focus on various aspects of Hindu mythology, cosmology, philosophy, and sociology. He is described as the preceptor of the royal sage Janaka, who ruled over Videha.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Sanatkum' is a modern adaptation of the ancient Sanskrit name 'Sanatana Kumara'. In modern context, this name is associated with practices and beliefs rooted in Ayurveda, mindfulness, and spirituality. Ayurveda is an ancient Indian system of medicine, and followers often incorporate its teachings into their daily lives for holistic well-being. Mindfulness is a practice of focusing one's attention on the present moment, and spirituality refers to a person's connection to something greater than themselves.
